name: Ui_DataPanel_Restore
summary: Writes the panel mode byte to work+0x2D544, copies 0x1F per-member 0x200-byte blocks into member records, copies the bag block from work+0x24A98 into the panel, and restores cached hashes/pane pointers to the work; the restore half of the mode-change path.
evidence: Callers Ui_DualDisplayWindow_SelectMode / Ui_TitlePagerWindow_SetupRows / Save_LoadSlotRecords; callees Ui_DataPanel_CopyFromWork, Member_RemoveItemAtSlot, Ui_MessageStyle_ApplyLevelA/B; loop over 0x1F members via func_0035EB98.

name: maybe_Object_ReleaseRefcountedChildren
summary: Damaged Thumb body with bad instruction data; refcount-decrement plus virtual slot +8 calls appear, but the control flow is unreliable.
evidence: Ghidra reports bad instruction data, unaff_r/in_ registers, halt_baddata; callers are Squirrel VM functions that do not fit a refcounted teardown.

name: maybe_Ui_CellGrid_InitSlots
summary: Initializes 16 display cell slots at +0x8BC4 (stride 0xB8) from a zeroed template with default vectors and 0xFF sentinel.
evidence: Loop over 16 slots copying 0x84-byte template via std_memcpy; only caller Ui_StatusWindow_RebuildSceneObjects; slot record layout inferred.

name: maybe_Ui_CellGrid_CopySlots
summary: Copies the 0x2E-word slot records from +0x8C7C down to +0x8BC4 and stores the incoming 0x2E-word record at +0x923C; same record layout as the cell-slot initializer.
evidence: Same 0x8BC4..0x92F4 window and 0x2E stride as 0x001932D0; only caller Field_SceneObject_RegisterInstance does not confirm a battle party owner.

name: maybe_SceneObject_DeepCopy
signature: void maybe_SceneObject_DeepCopy(void* dst, const void* src, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Deep-copies a large (~0x450-byte) object: 0x140-byte run buffer, 0x1E-word table, 8x4 and 0x68x2 element ranges plus 0xA0 bytes of auxiliary data, then fixes up self-relative pointers.
evidence: Callers are field actor/animation and battle-scene functions (Field_Actor_IsModelActionDone, BattleScene_UpdateScreenState0Main), not text; element type unknown.

name: maybe_Text_InitLineCache
signature: void maybe_Text_InitLineCache(TextLine* lines, const TextLine* source)
summary: Clears 255 0x18-byte line records then copies the first 0x11 bytes of each from a source template, re-initialising the message-line cache.
evidence: Two loops of 0xFF iterations with std_memcpy of 0x11 bytes; callers are Ui_ResetLargeScreenState and Text_MeasureOverflow, both unconfirmed.

name: maybe_Party_RemoveMember
summary: No dossier or decompiled body available; name cannot be verified.
evidence: No readable file or dossier; keeping the existing maybe_ name.

name: maybe_Text_DecodeName
summary: Copies a 0x84-byte record, runs it through the text layout builder and stores two result bytes into out[0]/out[1].
evidence: Callers PartyStatus_LoadNewestRecord and Ui_EquipWindow_InitMemberTables; 0x84-byte layout matches several text records and the two result bytes are unexplained.

name: maybe_Ui_EquipPart_SetStateIndex
signature: void maybe_Ui_EquipPart_SetStateIndex(EquipPart* self, unsigned int state, unsigned char state2, EquipPartState* out)

name: maybe_Ui_DungeonWindow_SetRowKind
summary: Initialises a row from a 0x29-byte record, clears id fields and maps record byte 0 to a row kind (0->7, 1->8, 2->9).
evidence: Callers are Field_Gimmick_ActivateComponent1D8 and maybe_Ui_CompositeWindow_Ctor1; the dungeon-window noun comes only from the vtable neighbourhood.

name: maybe_Gfx_SkeletalAnim_InitFrame
signature: void maybe_Gfx_SkeletalAnim_InitFrame(int self, unsigned char* frame)
summary: Initialises per-frame animation work: copies a 0x120-byte default table and selects node-group offsets by frame kind (5/6) and flags.
evidence: No callers; only named callee is std_memcpy; skeletal-animation context inferred from neighbouring animation vtable.

name: maybe_Gfx_CopyBlock24

name: maybe_Gfx_CopyBlock48

name: maybe_Gfx_CmdBuf_FlushStateBlockData
signature: int maybe_Gfx_CmdBuf_FlushStateBlockData(unsigned int* out, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int flags, GfxCmdBuf* self)
summary: Clears dirty counters of a command-buffer object and, unless bit 0 of flags is set, copies the stored command block to out and returns the aligned end pointer.

name: maybe_Gfx_CmdBuf_WriteColorBlock
signature: void maybe_Gfx_CmdBuf_WriteColorBlock(void* self, GfxCmdBuf* cmd, unsigned int listIndex, unsigned int entryIndex)

evidence: Only caller is Gfx_CharShadow_BuildCurveTable; 0x000500E0/0x000F00E1 headers and 0x218 stride explicit but list/entry meaning unproven.

name: maybe_Ui_DataPanel_SetTextRow

evidence: 18 callers (casino, field flag, ATM, poker payout, etc.) but body is only a 0x84-byte row copy plus name helper; SetTextRow role inferred from layout.

name: maybe_GameWork_RemoveActiveRecord
signature: void maybe_GameWork_RemoveActiveRecord(int self, int index, int count)
summary: Removes a record from a 0x14-byte-stride table at self+0x5FE4 by memcpy-shifting the following 0x8C-byte records down, then clears the tail and resets flags at +0x7B34/+0x7B38.
evidence: Only caller is maybe_Ui_ListWindow_AdvancePage5; body does std_memcpy shift with stride 0x14 and clears +0x7B34/+0x7B35/+0x7B38; table owner still inferred.

name: maybe_Gfx_CmdBuf_CopyBlocks
summary: Copies a run of 0x200-byte command-buffer blocks with std_memcpy, writing the 0x1FC-byte payload plus a masked header word per block.
evidence: 22 unaff_ uses, no PICA register write; only caller maybe_Field_ObjectSprite_BindHandles; block-copy behaviour only certain.

name: maybe_Ui_ItemDetail_Setup
summary: Fills the detail pane of an action window: sets message arg 5 from the selected entry, installs the format string, copies party member 0's stats/status into a local buffer for arg 6, then shows the pane.
evidence: Callees Message_SetArg, Ui_Pane_SetVisibleWithAnim, Ui_ActionWindow_Setup, Game_GetWork, func_0035EB98(member 0) confirm fill-detail-then-show reading; no callers.

name: maybe_Ui_JewelShopWindow_OpenSelect
summary: Opens the jewel-shop select pane by forcing the sub-pane at +0x1B8 visible with a constant 1.
evidence: Body is Ui_Pane_SetVisibleWithAnim(&self->selectPane,1) with constant 1; no callers; class identity from offsets only.

name: maybe_Ui_Selector_SetVisible
summary: Visibility override of a selector window: calls Ui_Pane_SetVisibleWithAnim and, when becoming visible with the animation byte at +0x48 set, resolves game work and starts the open tween.
evidence: Callees Ui_Pane_SetVisibleWithAnim, Ui_TextLayer_SetText, Game_GetWork, maybe_Ui_IsMenuOpen; vtable siblings are themselves maybe_, class uncertain.

name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_CloseAndReleaseCutscene
summary: Message-window close path: notifies the overlay helper via the scene-transition manager, releases the cutscene message and camera at self+0x70, tears the cutscene down and finishes the UI-core transition.
evidence: Named callees Cutscene_ReleaseMessageAndCamera, Cutscene_Teardown, Ui_SmithMenu_FinishTransition, Ui_GetSceneTransitionManager, Ui_GetCore; no callers.

name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_CloseAndNotifyCharacter
summary: Second close path of the message window: notifies the 2D field character handler with the window owner and message id, then releases the cutscene message/camera, tears down and finishes the UI-core transition.
evidence: Same named teardown chain as 0x0019EA58 plus Field2D_OnCharacterChanged; no callers.
